module_docs: `Metadata.Entry.SERIALIZER` — a var-int metadata type id followed by that
type's payload — is exposed here as [`MetadataEntryNetworkType`], which
delegates to the canonical entry codec
[`crate::entity::metadata::codec`]. That codec writes the same pair through
the payload codecs in [`crate::entity::metadata::payload_codec`], so every
metadata type — the item stack, the particles, the villager triple, the
profile and the thirteen variant types included — is byte-exact here.
This file used to carry its own copy of the payload table. It had drifted
from the canonical one: `TYPE_BLOCKSTATE`/`TYPE_OPT_BLOCKSTATE` resolved a
key to the block's *registry* id where Java writes the block's *state* id
(`Block.STATE_NETWORK_TYPE`), and the payload families Java resolves
through another class's network type panicked instead of encoding. The
canonical codec is the only copy now.
